title: ARC-Trust+: Asynchronous Riemannian Coordination for Trust-Aware Decentralised Federated Intrusion Detection under Drift and Byzantine Attack
description:
ARC-Trust+ is a fully decentralised framework for federated intrusion detection that combines a topology-aware exclusive neighbour cache with bounded staleness (TAEC), a Riemannian temporal deformation residual over symmetric positive-definite (SPD) covariance matrices (RTDR), a cryptographic canary consistency indicator (CCI), and composite trust evaluation (CTE) for trust-weighted aggregation and local isolation of Byzantine neighbours.

This record archives the experimental notebook, requirements, results and figures accompanying the manuscript. The framework is evaluated on five public datasets (CSE-CIC-IDS2018, CIDDS, Edge-IIoTset, ToN-IoT and UNSW-NB15) under non-IID partitioning, five concept-drift regimes, and sign-flip, Gaussian-noise and ALIE attacks. Datasets are not redistributed; the notebook downloads them from their public sources.
